conditions.displayName: No successful WriteObject calls to the raw bucket for 30 min

conditionAbsent.filter: metric.type="storage.googleapis.com/api/request_count" AND resource.type="gcs_bucket" AND resource.label.bucket_name="__BUCKET__" AND metric.label.method="WriteObject" AND metric.label.response_code="OK"

documentation.content:
The logger's failure mode is silence, not an error: this fires when the raw bucket has gone 30 minutes with no successful `WriteObject` call, meaning the archive has stopped growing even though nothing necessarily crashed. Check Cloud Run request logs for the `chargewatch-logger` service first, then Cloud Scheduler job history for `chargewatch-logger-dynamic` / `chargewatch-logger-static`.

Confirm in Metrics Explorer that the method label for the logger's uploads is WriteObject; if it differs, edit the filter in scripts/monitoring/dead-man.json and re-run setup-gcp.sh.

This policy is only trusted once both halves of the verification in `docs/specs/m1-logger.md` §8/§11 have been done by hand: pause the `chargewatch-logger-dynamic` Scheduler job and confirm this alert fires within ~30 minutes, then resume it and confirm the incident closes.
